description: Every industry/livelihood domain not shipped with real data in this release, with the reason and what would unblock it. Mirrors Package001_Geography, Package002_Education, and Package003_Healthcare's acquisition_backlog.json convention: no domain ships guessed or placeholder rows just to appear complete. Updated after the v2 deep-enrichment pass (2026-07-24) -- domain-level backlog below is unchanged from RC1 (this pass added field depth to existing rows, not new domains); see `known_dataset_specific_gaps` for the post-enrichment field-level picture and `reports/business_opportunity_enrichment_summary.md` for the full per-field fill-rate table.
environment_blocker_affecting_all_items: This session's organizational egress policy blocked direct WebFetch to .gov.in/.ac.in/.nic.in domains (confirmed HTTP 403 policy denial, re-tested live immediately before both the RC1 collection pass and the v2 enrichment pass). All datasets were collected via WebSearch snippets only (plus limited, explicitly-flagged Tier-5 qualitative sourcing in china_inspired_adapted_opportunities.csv). Government DIC/MSME/PMFME project-profile PDFs were located by URL in several cases but their content could only be seen via search snippet, not direct read -- this is the clearest example of a gap that would likely close with restored WebFetch access.

blocked_or_queued_domains.unblock_requires: Dedicated research pass with a defined narrower slice (e.g. just handloom cooperatives, or just organized garment manufacturing units) agreed with the requester first.

known_dataset_specific_gaps.gap: Post-enrichment (v1.0.0): 120 of 468 fields (25.6%) PENDING_VERIFICATION, concentrated in minimum_investment, estimated_setup_time_summary, seasonal_factors_summary, ai_tools_summary, and sustainability_summary -- no government project-profile-grade source was found for these. PMFME's AP-specific model-DPR archive (pmfmeap.org/model-micro-dprs) was located by URL but not fully mined. RC1-stage gaps (no government figure for coconut cold-pressed oil, TG/AP-scale seed processing) remain.

Post-enrichment (v1.0.0): 83 of 432 fields (19.2%) PENDING_VERIFICATION, concentrated in working_capital_summary, estimated_setup_time_summary, seasonal_factors_summary, and sustainability_summary -- 0/12 rows sourced for these specific fields. minimum_investment remains largely unsourced (no credible government/NASSCOM costing figure found). No AP-specific women-in-tech scheme exists (WE-HUB is Telangana-only). TG/AP-specific Shops & Establishment/Professional Tax thresholds unverified.

Post-enrichment (v1.0.0): 89 of 396 fields (22.5%) PENDING_VERIFICATION. minimum_investment confirmed only for PM Vishwakarma-covered trades (Carpenter, Mason among the 9 researched); no authoritative figure for the rest. No named formal training body found for Aluminium Fabrication or Borewell Drilling. AP-specific electrical licensing rules unverified (only Telangana's 2018 Electrical Licensing Regulations confirmed).

Not enriched in the v2 pass (intentionally -- see docs/METHODOLOGY.md 'Why msme_entrepreneurship_support_schemes was left alone'). The relationship between Telangana's older T-IDEA/T-PRIDE framework and the new 2024 MSME Policy remains unresolved -- conflicting subsidy figures were found and left PENDING_VERIFICATION rather than guessed. No confirmed APIIC rename found (an old 'CIAP' legal reference was checked but not adopted as an active change).

Post-enrichment (v1.0.0): 28 of 324 fields (8.6%) PENDING_VERIFICATION, concentrated in minimum_investment (8/9 rows). Facebook Marketplace, named in the package brief's own examples, was checked and confirmed NOT officially launched in India -- documented explicitly. 4 rows/fields explicitly flagged as Tier-5/anecdotal sourcing (a Dukaan seller via Quartz, a YouTube creator via a single industry blog) rather than authoritative documents. No unified AP-wide homestay policy document was found (only a Visakhapatnam pilot).
